body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Surfaces, the event is providing the venue for all elements of the floor covering industry to meet face-to-face and develop courses of action to address the opportunities for growth in their business, took place in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5, 2009.

More than 35,000 retailers, distributors, architects, designers, installers and builders and manufacturers came to Surfaces. In keeping with the marketplace trends, this year's event focused its efforts around helping the flooring professional stimulate their business with innovative ways to market their products and to redesign their application and installation of every type of floor covering product imaginable.

The official sponsor of Surfaces is the World Floor Covering Association (WFCA), the floor covering industry's largest advocacy organization representing floor covering retailers, contractors and allied service providers throughout North America.

Surfaces is owned and produced by Hanley Wood Exhibitions, producer of World of Concrete, International Roofing Expo, Remodeling Show, JLC Live Residential Construction Shows, International Pool / Spa / Patio Expo, World of Concrete Mexico and CONSTRUCT 2008.
